name: Generative Models: Noisewright
subtitle: VAE, GAN, Diffusion, Flows
shortDescription: Move the dials, watch noise become a picture, then meet the equation. A graduate course on VAEs, GANs, flows and diffusion with sources for every claim.
longDescription:
Learn how generative models work by playing with them. Noisewright is a graduate-level course on the families behind modern image, audio and text generation: autoregressive models, variational autoencoders, normalizing flows, GANs, score-based models, diffusion and flow matching, guidance and latent diffusion, and how to evaluate them honestly.

Every idea starts with a real situation. A cafe forecasting two rush hours shows what KL divergence punishes. A forger and a detective show the GAN game. A photograph developing out of fog shows how a diffusion model restores a picture one step at a time. A keyboard guessing the next key shows the chain rule. You move the dials, the numbers change, and only then do you meet the equation that describes what you just saw. Tap any symbol and it lights up in the picture with its meaning and live value.

WHAT YOU GET
- 10 units, 37 short lesson cards, each with a quick check
- 17 interactive benches that run the real math on your device, no server, no account
- About 390 practice questions with worked reasons, computed from your own settings where possible
- Unit checks of six questions, a mixed drill and optional mock tests
- A rest-friendly design: sessions of a few minutes, a good place to stop, and no streak pressure
- Sources for every claim: papers such as the original VAE, GAN, normalizing flow, DDPM, score-SDE, flow matching and Transformer work, plus Stanford, MIT, CMU and Berkeley course pages, open in a window inside the app and can be read offline as stored records
- Text size controls from 85 to 200 percent, labels for screen readers, no flashing content

HONEST BY DESIGN
No expert reviewed this course. Instead, every bench number is recomputed by a separate reference program, every quiz answer is re-derived by code, and every claim lists at least two sources whose pages were checked. Fast-moving facts are dated on a "content as of" card. Nothing here is legal, medical or financial advice.

FREE WITH OPTIONAL MEMBERSHIP
Everything for learning is free. Ads appear only between activities, never inside a bench or a question. An optional monthly membership removes ads and unlocks mock tests; free users can watch a short video to earn a mock credit. Cancel anytime; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

Who it is for: students and engineers who know deep learning and probability and want to derive and run the main generative-model families.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
